caseName: United States ex rel. Edwards v. Taft
caseNameFull: The United States ex rel. Frank D. Edwards, Lieutenant, etc., in Error v. William H. Taft, Secretary of War
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Henry A. Craig and Mr. J. W. Catharine.for plaintiff in error., The Attorney General and Mr. Solicitor General Hoyt for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of South Carolina v. Seymour, 153 U. S. 353; United States v. Lynch, 137 U. S. 280; United States ex rel. Phillips v. Ware, Commissioner; Same v. Hitchcock, Secretary, 189 U. S. 507.
